description_citations.text: "Weatherlight Crew". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Hanna describes the king's artificer who was also his jester.
timeline.quote: Unfortunately, the royal artificer was also the king's jester."

citation.text: Bubble Matrix (Weatherlight, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Gerrard falls in love with navigator Hanna.
timeline.quote: Gerrard fell in love with the ship's navigator, Hanna

citation.text: "Gerrard Capashen", section "Sisay and the Legacy". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Hanna leaves Tolaria to study artifice at Argivian University in New Argive, becoming estranged from her father.
timeline.quote: Hanna and Barrin were not on speaking terms for many years as a result.

citation.text: "Hanna", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Hanna befriends Orim at university and the two join the crew of the Weatherlight.
timeline.quote: Hanna befriended Orim while at the university, and later the pair joined the crew of Weatherlight .

citation.text: "Hanna", section "The Weatherlight". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gerrard leaves after Rofellos dies, leaving Hanna feeling abandoned; years later he rejoins and love rekindles.
timeline.quote: leading Hanna to feel abandoned and betrayed by his departure.

citation.text: "Hanna", section "The Weatherlight". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Hanna loses a competition to Ertai, who then derides her artifacts.
timeline.quote: Hanna challenged Ertai to a competition which she ultimately lost

citation.text: "Hanna", section "The Weatherlight". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Mirri and Hanna search the Skyshroud for Gerrard; Hanna saves Mirri from a shapeshifter and they come to an understanding.
timeline.quote: Hanna saved Mirri from, earning her Mirri's respect

citation.text: "Mirri", section "The Weatherlight". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The elves capture Mirri and Hanna, but Gerrard is proclaimed the Korvecdal, leading to an alliance with Eladamri's rebels.
timeline.quote: leading to an alliance between the crew and the rebels

citation.text: "Mirri", section "The Weatherlight". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Hanna and Mirri face slivers that protect each other.
timeline.quote: We must learn how they protect each other.

citation.text: Armor Sliver (Tempest, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The swarm ignores the destruction of the artificial slivers.
timeline.quote: They clearly were not the leaders," Hanna cursed.

citation.text: Disenchant (Tempest, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Mirri apologizes to Hanna for thinking her a burden.
timeline.quote: I thought you a burden, and you saved my life.

citation.text: Gallantry (Tempest, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Gerrard vanishes into the maw of trees as Hanna mourns.
timeline.quote: As Gerrard's form vanished into the maw of trees

citation.text: Abandon Hope (Tempest, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Predator lists the Weatherlight and Hanna screams.
timeline.quote: the *Weatherlight* suddenly listed.

citation.text: Sudden Impact (Tempest, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Barrin provides Ertai as the Weatherlight's mage; Ertai defeats Hanna in a contest.
timeline.quote: Ertai challenged Hanna to a competition which he won easily.

citation.text: "Ertai", section "Journey to Rath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Eladamri, who had imprisoned Mirri and Hanna, releases them after Gerrard explains.
timeline.quote: He was brought to the home of the elvish lord Eladamri

citation.text: "Gerrard Capashen", section "Rath and Storm". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: On Rath the Predator attacks; Karn and Tahngarth are captured and Gerrard is thrown overboard, so Hanna takes charge of the ship.
timeline.quote: Hanna took charge of the ship with Mirri 's support and landed the ship in the forest below.

citation.text: "Hanna", section "Rath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Hanna defeats a shapeshifter and bonds with Mirri, then both are taken prisoner by the Skyshroud elves.
timeline.quote: through ingenuity, Hanna managed to defeat the monster.

citation.text: "Hanna", section "Rath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gerrard, proclaimed the Korvecdal, allies the crew with the elven rebels, who help them into the Stronghold.
timeline.quote: proclaimed the Korvecdal by the Oracle en -Vec , leading to an alliance between the crew and the rebels.

citation.text: "Hanna", section "Rath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Lyna tells Hanna that Ertai has prepared the portal off Rath and the crew leaves.
timeline.quote: When the soltari Lyna appeared to inform her that Ertai had prepared the portal off of Rath and demanded that they leave

citation.text: "Hanna", section "Rath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Karn convinces the Sliver Queen to release the Legacy after Hanna realizes how the hive mind works.
timeline.quote: Karn was able to convince the Sliver Queen to release the Legacy to him

citation.text: "Sliver", section "Rath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Hanna remarks that wizards begin by exiling themselves and end by exiling everyone else.
timeline.quote: It is the way of most wizards to begin by exiling themselves and to end by exiling everyone else.

citation.text: Dark Banishing (Oversized League Prizes, 1998), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Karn and Hanna stand over the recovered Legacy artifacts like loving parents.
timeline.quote: Karn and Hanna stood over the recovered Legacy artifacts

citation.text: Treasure Trove (Exodus, 1998), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Lyna cries that Ertai reports the portal is open though not for long.
timeline.quote: Ertai sends word that the portal is open—but not for long!

citation.text: Erratic Portal (Exodus, 1998), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Hanna doubts what the skyshaper will do to the ship.
timeline.quote: I can't guarantee what it'll do to the ship.

citation.text: Skyshaper (Exodus, 1998), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Gerrard rejoins the Weatherlight and appoints Tahngarth first mate.
timeline.quote: Gerrard is introduced to old and new crewmates and appoints Tahngarth as the first mate

citation.text: "Rath and Storm", section ""Gerrard's Tale", by Michael Ryan". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ertai defeats a fog elemental with the Chimeric Sphere.
timeline.quote: attacks from the mists surrounding the hill, which Ertai defeats by piloting the Chimeric Sphere with a Mind Stone

citation.text: "Rath and Storm", section ""Ertai's Tale" (Hannovi Braddock)". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The moggs break the Thran crystal, stranding the crew on Rath.
timeline.quote: the moggs broke the Thran crystal during their attack, stranding them on Rath

citation.text: "Rath and Storm", section ""Hanna's Tale" ( Miranda Horner )". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Hanna kills a shapeshifter in the Skyshroud forest.
timeline.quote: She disarms the monster and slices it open

citation.text: "Rath and Storm", section ""Hanna's Tale" ( Miranda Horner )". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gerrard and Hanna share a long kiss.
timeline.quote: Gerrard and Hanna share a long kiss

citation.text: "Rath and Storm", section ""Hanna's Tale" ( Miranda Horner )". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Slivers burst into the Weatherlight in the Furnace of Rath.
timeline.quote: the slivers burst through the walls of the cave to attack the Weatherlight

citation.text: "Rath and Storm", section ""Starke's Tale" ( Jennifer Clarke-Wilkes )". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Hanna saves the ship from burning with an improvised lightning rod.
timeline.quote: Hanna made an improvised lightning rod from a piece of railing and saved the ship from burning.

citation.text: "Rath and Storm", section "A Dark Room". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tahngarth returns mutilated, carrying the wounded Mirri and Crovax.
timeline.quote: Tahngarth reappears, emerging from the Stronghold mutilated by Volrath's tortures and carrying the wounded Mirri and Crovax.

citation.text: "Rath and Storm", section ""The Weatherlight's Tale" ( Francis Lebaron )". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Karn returns with the Legacy pieces and the Skyshaper.
timeline.quote: Karn returns with the missing pieces of the Legacy as well as the Skyshaper

citation.text: "Rath and Storm", section ""The Weatherlight's Tale" ( Francis Lebaron )". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Hanna drags the Predator into the Stronghold.
timeline.quote: Hanna orders the steersman to speed up, dragging the Predator behind them and causing it to crash into the Stronghold.

citation.text: "Rath and Storm", section ""The Weatherlight's Tale" ( Francis Lebaron )". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Hanna fires a beam from the steering wheel at the ornithopters.
timeline.quote: She then causes a beam of light to fire from the steering wheel

citation.text: "Rath and Storm", section ""The Weatherlight's Tale" ( Francis Lebaron )". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Hanna curses that the swarm is unmoved by the destruction of artificial slivers and says they must do it the hard way.
timeline.quote: I guess we'll have to do this the hard way.

citation.text: Disenchant (World Championship Decks 1998, 1998), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Ertai, tested on the Chimeric Sphere, activates it against a fog elemental, which destroys it.
timeline.quote: Ertai ended his abeyance spell and activated the sphere

citation.text: "The Legacy", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After Gerrard, Tahngarth and Karn are arrested in Mercadia, Sisay, Hanna and Orim strike a deal with the Chief Magistrate to travel to Saprazzo for the Power Matrix.
timeline.quote: After the arrest of Gerrard , Tahngarth , and Karn in Mercadia

citation.text: "The Legacy", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Hanna says she has seen Serra's strength in angels' wings and sorrow on ruins brought by the Lord of the Wastes.
timeline.quote: I have felt your sorrow rain down on the ruins brought by the Lord of the Wastes.

citation.text: Serra's Blessing (Classic Sixth Edition, 1999), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Hanna is born in 4181, the last known individual born of the project.
timeline.quote: The last known individual to be born of the Project was Hanna

citation.text: "Bloodline Project", section "End of the Project". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Weatherlight crash-lands on Mercadia, the Cho-Arrim attack, and Hanna and others are arrested.
timeline.quote: The Weatherlight crash-landed on Mercadia after departing Rath.

citation.text: "Hanna", section "Mercadia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The crew escapes Mercadia City with the Cho-Arrim prisoners and learns of the myths of Ramos.
timeline.quote: Here, they learned of the myths of Ramos and why the Cho-Arrim had taken the Weatherlight to begin with

citation.text: "Hanna", section "Mercadia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Power Matrix is stolen and the women are framed; Cho-Manno finds the real thief too late.
timeline.quote: the Power Matrix was stolen shortly after their arrival, and the women were framed for the crime.

citation.text: "Hanna", section "Mercadia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Volrath's plot is revealed; during the Revolution on Mercadia the crew escapes aboard the empowered Weatherlight with Ramos's help.
timeline.quote: Weatherlight managed to escape when Ramos himself came to their aid.

citation.text: "Hanna", section "Mercadia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Takara brokers a new deal: the crew will repair the Weatherlight for the magistrate in exchange for freedom; Sisay, Hanna and Orim head to Saprazzo for a needed artifact.
timeline.quote: Takara brokers a new deal with the magistrate

citation.text: "Mercadian Masques", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A sudden flood carries off the Weatherlight with warriors on boats during Mirri's memorial.
timeline.quote: A memorial service for Mirri and the other dead is interrupted by a sudden flood that brings in a band of warriors on boats and that starts to carry off the Weatherlight.

citation.text: "Mercadian Masques (novel)", section "Chapter by chapter summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tahngarth confesses that he wishes he had died on Rath rather than live with the changes Volrath made.
timeline.quote: He wishes he had died there instead of having to live with the twisted changes effected upon him by Volrath.

citation.text: "Mercadian Masques (novel)", section "Chapter by chapter summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Squee and Atalla drug the guards' wine to free the crew.
timeline.quote: The wine proves to be drugged, and Atalla secures the key to their shackles.

citation.text: "Mercadian Masques (novel)", section "Chapter by chapter summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The magistrate lets the crew keep the Weatherlight in exchange for a mission to Saprazzo for the Matrix.
timeline.quote: The magistrate agrees to allow them to repair and keep the Weatherlight, in exchange for using it on a mission of the magistrate's choice.

citation.text: "Mercadian Masques (novel)", section "Chapter by chapter summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Disguised as guards, the crew and Cho-Manno free Gerrard using a storm.
timeline.quote: The new guards are the rest of the Weatherlight crew, plus Cho-Manno.

citation.text: "Mercadian Masques (novel)", section "Chapter by chapter summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Takara, morphing into Volrath, takes Hanna and Karn captive and forces Hanna to repair the Weatherlight.
timeline.quote: soon she morphs into her form as Volrath, who takes them captive.

citation.text: "Mercadian Masques (novel)", section "Chapter by chapter summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Weatherlight engine starts just as Volrath shoots at Squee.
timeline.quote: Just as Volrath shoots a crossbow bolt at Squee, the engine starts and the bolt just misses.

citation.text: "Mercadian Masques (novel)", section "Chapter by chapter summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gerrard and Sisay are pulled aboard the Weatherlight, which Karn now controls through its engine.
timeline.quote: Now a rope comes down and Hanna and Tahngarth pull the two up on board.

citation.text: "Mercadian Masques (novel)", section "Chapter by chapter summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: With hostages held, the Mercadians force Hanna, Sisay and Orim to retrieve the Power Matrix from Saprazzo, then steal it and murder its guardians.
timeline.quote: the Mercadians betrayed them again, stealing the artifact and murdering its guardians while attempting to frame Orim

citation.text: "Revolution on Mercadia", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Under Volrath's control, Hanna, Karn and Squee are forced to repair the Weatherlight; the revolutionary forces attack.
timeline.quote: forced to repair the Weatherlight under the threat of Squee’s execution

citation.text: "Revolution on Mercadia", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tahngarth tells Hanna he feels himself a monster and sees his mutation as punishment for his vanity.
timeline.quote: he admitted that he felt himself a monster now

citation.text: "Tahngarth", section "Mercadia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Barrin defends Benalia, Keld and Urborg before retreating, and learns at Koilos that Hanna has died of a Phyrexian disease and exhumes her body.
timeline.quote: Barrin exhumed the body of his daughter from the sands of Koilos.

citation.text: "Barrin", section "The Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Hanna dies of the Phyrexian plague at Koilos.
timeline.quote: shortly after their arrival, Hanna died.

citation.text: "Gerrard Capashen", section "The Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Hanna contracts a Phyrexian plague at the start of the Invasion and dies hours before Orim's cure is ready.
timeline.quote: Soon, Orim devised a cure, but it came hours too late to save her.

citation.text: "Hanna", section "The Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Barrin leaves Urza's service, exhumes Hanna's body, reburies her on Tolaria next to his wife, and razes the island to glass.
timeline.quote: Reburying her next to his wife, he then razed the island to glass.

citation.text: "Hanna", section "The Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Yawgmoth tempts Gerrard with a false promise to revive Hanna.
timeline.quote: Yawgmoth later tempted Gerrard with the promise of bringing his beloved back to life, but that was only an elaborate ruse.

citation.text: "Hanna", section "The Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Phyrexians kill everyone in Benalia City and decimate Urza's armies; Hanna is wounded and contracts Phyrexian Plague.
timeline.quote: Orim diagnoses Hanna with Phyrexian Plague.

citation.text: "Invasion (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The crew captures Phyrexians on Rath and Orim devises a serum that stops the plague, but it is too late for Hanna.
timeline.quote: The crew is made immune, but it's too late to do anything for Hanna.

citation.text: "Invasion (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Thaddeus is captured and vivisected by Tavoc; during Eladamri's duel with Agnate, Hanna dies.
timeline.quote: but during the duel, Hanna passes away.

citation.text: "Invasion (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Furious that Urza hid Hanna's death, Barrin exhumes her body and casts the obliterate spell, destroying Tolaria.
timeline.quote: Furious, Barrin exhumes his daughter's body and travels to Tolaria, casting the obliterate spell, completely destroying the entire island.

citation.text: "Invasion (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At Koilos, Thaddeus is dissected by Tsabo, and Eladamri and Agnate destroy the Gate to Phyrexia; Thaddeus and Hanna die.
timeline.quote: together they destroyed the Gate to Phyrexia

citation.text: "Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria", section "First stage". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Yawgmoth makes Gerrard and Urza duel; Gerrard decapitates Urza and discovers the Hanna he fought for was Yawgmoth in disguise.
timeline.quote: the duel ended with Gerrard decapitating Urza

citation.text: "Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria", section "Final stage". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Hanna dies of Phyrexian Plague during the Phyrexian Invasion.
timeline.quote: Hanna died from Phyrexian Plague.

citation.text: "Tolaria", section "Obliteration of Tolaria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Barrin seals Hanna in a sarcophagus and obliterates Tolaria with a massive spell after the Phyrexians swarm it.
timeline.quote: he sealed Hanna in an impenetrable sarcophagus and obliterated the entire island with a massive spell

citation.text: "Tolaria", section "Obliteration of Tolaria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Barrin destroys the island with its occupants while grieving his daughter Hanna.
timeline.quote: Barrin destroyed the whole island along with all of its occupants

citation.text: "Tolarian Academy", section "Destruction". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gerrard rejects Yawgmoth's false Hanna.
timeline.quote: You're not my Hanna!

citation.text: Jilt (Apocalypse, 2001), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Gerrard wins the duel by decapitating Urza, rejects Yawgmoth's reward, sees through a Hanna-avatar, and is flung out of Phyrexia.
timeline.quote: Gerrard wins the duel by decapitating Urza.

citation.text: "Apocalypse (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Hanna kills a shapeshifter, then she and Mirri are captured by Skyshroud elves.
timeline.quote: they were soon captured by Skyshroud elves.

citation.text: "Assault on Rath", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Hanna drags the Predator into a collision with the Stronghold.
timeline.quote: Hanna, acting quickly, managed to drag the Predator into a collision with the Stronghold.

citation.text: "Assault on Rath", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Weatherlight crosses the portal boosted by the Skyshaper, leaving Ertai behind on Rath.
timeline.quote: he was unable to save him, leaving him behind on Rath.

citation.text: "Assault on Rath", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Barrin forbids Hanna from studying artifacts, causing a falling-out and her move to New Argive.
timeline.quote: Barrin forbade Hanna from studying the artifacts

citation.text: "Barrin", section "Hanna". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Barrin, Rayne and Hanna are briefly turned undead when Yawgmoth's death cloud enters the plane.
timeline.quote: were all briefly turned into undead

citation.text: "Barrin", section "Undeath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Yawgmoth's death cloud briefly turns Hanna, Barrin and Rayne into undead.
timeline.quote: Barrin, Rayne and Hanna were all briefly turned into undead during the last stage of the Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria

citation.text: "Hanna", section "Undeath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sisay, Orim and Hanna arrive in Saprazzo seeking the Power Matrix; Sisay is wounded after a sailor harpoons a Breaker and Orim heals her.
timeline.quote: only to be saved by Orim, who called for peace and used her healing abilities to restore her captain.

citation.text: "Saprazzo", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Lahaime stages his own execution to feed the Mercadians false intelligence; the crew gets safe passage back to Mercadia.
timeline.quote: Lahaime staged his own "execution" before Oustrathmer

citation.text: "Saprazzo", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Hanna sees unsettling unanimity among slivers and urges Sisay to keep the ship at a distance.
timeline.quote: she urged Sisay to keep the ship at a safe distance.

citation.text: Sinew Sliver (Planar Chaos, 2007), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Hanna muses, stroking a lotus petal, about the greed such a flower inspires.
timeline.quote: such a lovely flower inspiring such greed.

citation.text: Lotus Petal (From the Vault: Exiled, 2009), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Lyna cries out that Ertai has opened the portal as Hanna's sword passes through her.
timeline.quote: In Barrin's name!

citation.text: Erratic Portal (Tempest Remastered, 2015), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Gerrard abandoned the Weatherlight and the Legacy quest.
timeline.quote: Gerrard abandoned the Weatherlight and the Legacy quest

citation.text: "Attack on Crovax's Estate", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Multani forms a new Weatherlight figurehead in the form of Gaea, using Hanna's features.
timeline.quote: Multani formed a new figurehead for the Skyship Weatherlight in the form of Gaea

citation.text: "Gaea", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Recalled to Koilos by Urza, Barrin learns that his daughter Hanna died of the Phyrexian plague and Urza never told him.
timeline.quote: she had died from the Phyrexian plague

citation.text: "Obliteration of Tolaria", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Barrin recovers Hanna's body and returns to Tolaria, finding it overrun by Phyrexians.
timeline.quote: Barrin recovered Hanna's body and returned to Tolaria

citation.text: "Obliteration of Tolaria", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Barrin places Hanna in the tomb of her mother Rayne and draws on mana from five lands to become a living sylex.
timeline.quote: He became a vessel of pure destruction, a living sylex .

citation.text: "Obliteration of Tolaria", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Barrin perishes in the blast; only Rayne and Hanna in their sarcophagi remain untouched.
timeline.quote: Barrin himself perished in the blast, his mortal form consumed by the magnitude of his magic.

citation.text: "Obliteration of Tolaria", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Volrath tortures Squee to force Hanna to fix the Weatherlight; allies intervene.
timeline.quote: Squee was tortured by Volrath to ensure compliance from Hanna
